note: Store-before-read aliasing: node A2 is placed 0x24 bytes above A1 so A1's `+0x30` stamp lands exactly on A2's `+0x0c` child field. The stamped depth is 0xffffffff, so depth+1 = 0 erases A2's seeded child (0x8c250100) before A2 is visited; A2 must therefore take the `bt` skip instead of recursing. Depends on the 0x8c05cac4 store preceding the 0x8c05cac6 load.
